'''January 2002 Lancaster tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lancaster, Pennsylvania on 26 January 2002. It is known from Rypcord Kline's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3298">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-26-lancaster-01-26-02d3298/ lancaster-01-26-02], DeckTech (Rypcord "Rypcord" Kline, 26 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-26-lancaster-01-26-02d3298/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 January 2002
* '''Site:''' Lancaster, Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 8
